intro.title: Building Trust. Empowering Skill. Transforming Local Services.
intro.p1: In many communities, finding a reliable artisan is still based on guesswork, word-of-mouth, or chance. Skilled professionals struggle to get visibility. Clients struggle to find trusted hands. Time is lost. Money is wasted. Trust is broken.
intro.p2: Finding a good artisan shouldn’t feel like gambling.
intro.p3: We’ve all been there, asking friends for contacts, calling numbers that don’t go through, waiting for someone who never shows up, or paying for work that doesn’t meet expectations. At the same time, thousands of skilled artisans wake up every morning ready to work but struggle to find steady clients.
intro.p4: FIXIT was created to solve this simple but powerful problem: connecting people who need work done with people who are ready to do it safely, transparently, and professionally.
intro.p5: FIXIT was created to change that.
intro.p6: We are building a structured, technology-driven ecosystem that connects verified artisans to clients in a transparent, efficient, and secure way. From electricians and plumbers to carpenters, painters, and technicians, FIXIT exists to bring professionalism, accountability, and opportunity into the local service economy.

why.title: Why We Exist
why.p1: Africa has talent. Cameroon has talent. What has been missing is structure, trust, and accessibility.
why.p2: FIXIT was founded on one belief:
why.p3: Skilled work deserves visibility. Clients deserve reliability.
why.p4: We are not just creating an app. We are building infrastructure for the informal service sector.

what.title: What We Do
what.l3: Skilled artisans to consistent job opportunities
what.p2: Through digital verification, ratings, secure payments, and clear job tracking, we are creating a marketplace where both clients and artisans feel protected and respected.
what.p3: FIXIT gives clients access to verified artisans, clear pricing, real reviews, and structured communication. It gives artisans visibility, credibility, and consistent opportunities to grow their income.
what.p4: Whether it’s fixing a leaking pipe, wiring a house, painting a room, installing tiles, repairing a generator, or handling a full construction project — FIXIT makes the process easier, faster, and more reliable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: As more people across Africa use smartphones and the internet every day, finding reliable service providers online is becoming the new normal. FIXIT is built to make this easier, by understanding how our local markets work and using smart technology to connect trusted artisans with people who need their services. Hence, we aim to professionalize and digitize local artisan services by creating a platform that promotes trust, transparency, and economic empowerment.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: To become Africa’s leading service-connection platform — setting a new standard for how skilled labor is discovered, trusted, and rewarded

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.p1: We believe technology should solve real problems. FIXIT is our solution to one of the most overlooked yet essential sectors of everyday life.

closing.title: This Is More Than an App
closing.p1: FIXIT is about dignity in skilled labor. It is about giving artisans the tools to grow. It is about giving clients confidence before work even begins.
closing.p2: We are building the future of trusted local services.
closing.p3: And this is only the beginning.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about FIXIT and how we work.

q1.question: How do I find a reliable artisan?
q1.answer: Simply download the FIXIT app, select the service you need, and we'll match you with verified artisans in your area. You can then review their profiles, ratings, and previous work.

q2.question: Are all artisans verified?
q2.answer: Yes. Every artisan on our platform undergoes a rigorous vetting process, including identity verification, background checks, and technical skill assessments.

q3.question: How much does it cost to use FIXIT?
q3.answer: Downloading and browsing the app is completely free. Prices for services are transparently negotiated between you and the artisan, with secure payment options available within the app.

q4.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
q4.answer: FIXIT provides dispute resolution support. If you're unhappy with a service, you can contact our support team through the app, and we'll help mediate and find a solution.

q5.question: How can I join as an artisan?
q5.answer: You can download the FIXIT Pro app and follow the registration process. You'll need to provide your credentials and undergo our verification process to start receiving job requests.
